elaine-rt: Heads-up: slimline prefetch + cache-window tuning went to canary this morning. dropping numbers here.
mark-bench: sweet — summary please (p50/p95/p99 + cost)?
elaine-rt: p50 ~ flat, p95 -9%, p99 -14% on mixed conv workloads. token cost down ~10% in canary.
nidhi-sre: any 5xx or memory regressions?
elaine-rt: no 5xx uptick. GPU memory +60MB on average; added alert for +180MB. one short-lived GC spike during config warmup but resolved.
samir-ml: did this change packing logic or only prefetch heuristics?
elaine-rt: mostly prefetch heuristics and smaller cache-window to reduce eviction churn. tiny tweak in packer to prefer ready requests with prefetched KV.
mark-bench: bench command for repro:```bash
./bench_tool --model conv-medium --qps 350 --seq-dist short,med --dur 30m --prefetch slimline --cache-window 30s
```
elaine-rt: baseline vs canary: p99 210ms -> 180ms; p95 95ms -> 86ms; cost/token $0.00042 -> $0.00038; kv-hit +19%.
nidhi-sre: rollout plan? monitoring checks?
elaine-rt: staged: canary -> 25% -> 60% -> full over 4h. checks: p99, 5xx, kv-hit, gpu_mem.used. auto-rollback if p99 regresses >7% for 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary started for group: conv-slimline-canary. 25% -> health checks running.
mark-bench: graphs look clean at T+20m. kv-hit stable.
elaine-rt: I'll post bench plots and PR link in the channel after full rollout. good job team :tada:
